posts.title: What to Expect From AGI: My Speculations
posts.description: AGI attracts sweeping predictions, yet many discussions overlook the constraints that shape real intelligence and new technologies alike: cost, energy, maintenance and the deep integration into human civilisation. AGI may well be achievable, but perhaps far more expensive, fragile and bounded than the grand narratives suggest. What follows is one plausible future built on that premise.

posts.title: Technical Debt Defined
posts.description: Technical debt is one of the most persistent and useful metaphors in software engineering and it is also one of the least clearly defined. This post sets out a clear, rigorous definition aligned with current research and practice.

posts.title: Module-First Development: Designing for Testability and Change
posts.description: Unit testing and modularity once promised confident change and fearless refactoring. Too often the reality was brittle tests, paralysed teams and slow progress. Module-First Development (MFD) seeks to restore that promise.
